name: DO NOT SAVE ME
source:
A dark tale where a maiden fears an obsessive knight as much as her monstrous captor. 

[Edited from [url=https://cozystars.itch.io/donotsaveme]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個黑暗的故事。少女懼怕那個執迷於她的騎士，絲毫不亞於懼怕囚禁她的怪物。

［編譯自[url=https://cozystars.itch.io/donotsaveme]itch.io[/url]］
